reference.name: electron_temperature
reference.description: Energy-equivalent measure of the mean random kinetic energy per electron in the bulk electron population, defined by its second velocity moment.

reference.name: electron_density
reference.description: Free-electron number density is the number of unbound electrons per physical volume, with population selection and spatial aggregation defined by each specialization.

reference.name: safety_factor
reference.description: Signed ratio of toroidal to poloidal field-line winding on a magnetic flux surface, equal to the toroidal turns made during one poloidal circuit.

reference.name: plasma_current
reference.description: Net toroidal electric current carried by the entire plasma column, obtained by integrating toroidal current density over its enclosed poloidal cross-section.

reference.name: poloidal_magnetic_flux
reference.description: Poloidal magnetic flux is the signed surface integral of the magnetic field over a surface bounded by a closed toroidal contour of a nested magnetic flux surface. It labels nested magnetic flux surfaces and is complementary to toroidal magnetic flux.

reference.name: atomic_count
reference.description: Stoichiometric multiplicity of a selected element within the chemical formula of an atomic or molecular species.

reference.name: atomic_mass
reference.description: Mass parameter assigned to a specified ion or neutral particle species, encoding its isotope or constituent composition for inertial and transport calculations.

reference.name: radial_coordinate_of_line_of_sight
reference.description: Major-radius coordinate of a specified geometric point associated with a line of sight, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

reference.name: vertical_coordinate_of_line_of_sight
reference.description: Signed vertical coordinate of a designated point defining a diagnostic line of sight in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

reference.name: atomic_number
reference.description: Nuclear proton count identifying the selected element in a plasma or neutral-particle species, independent of isotope and ionization state.

reference.name: ion_charge
reference.description: Dimensionless density-weighted mean ionic charge number for a specified ion species, combining its represented ionic charge states into one mean value.

reference.name: ion_state_maximum_charge_number
reference.description: Upper ionization charge-number bound of an ion charge-state bundle, identifying the highest ionic charge state represented.

reference.name: normalized_poloidal_flux_coordinate
reference.description: Normalized poloidal flux coordinate is a radial label for nested magnetic flux surfaces based on poloidal magnetic flux. It is zero at the magnetic axis and one at the last closed flux surface; for a line-of-sight locus, it denotes the minimum value reached along the line.

reference.name: poloidal_magnetic_flux_at_plasma_boundary
reference.description: Signed poloidal magnetic flux evaluated on the last closed flux surface, providing the outer reference for normalized poloidal-flux coordinates.

reference.name: toroidal_angle_of_measurement_position
reference.description: Toroidal angular coordinate locating a measurement position around the machine symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

reference.name: normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate
reference.description: Dimensionless radial label equal to the square root of toroidal magnetic flux normalized between the magnetic axis and equilibrium boundary.

reference.name: area_of_diagnostic_aperture
reference.description: Geometric area of the designated diagnostic aperture surface that admits or collects radiation or particles.

reference.name: volume_of_flux_surface
reference.description: Geometric volume contained within a nested magnetic flux surface, cumulative from the magnetic axis toward the outermost closed surface.

reference.name: toroidal_flux_coordinate
reference.description: Non-negative, radius-like label of a nested magnetic flux surface, derived from enclosed toroidal magnetic flux using a positive reference vacuum toroidal field.

reference.name: reference_major_radius
reference.description: Nonnegative perpendicular distance from the toroidal symmetry axis to a designated reference location, serving as the major-radius coordinate where the vacuum toroidal magnetic field is specified in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: poloidal_angle_of_plasma_boundary_gap
sample.description: Orientation of a plasma-boundary gap vector directed away from its reference point, measured clockwise from the radial cylindrical direction (grad R) in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: poloidal_magnetic_flux_at_pellet_path
sample.description: Poloidal magnetic flux at a pellet-path point is the value of the equilibrium poloidal magnetic-flux function evaluated at the position of a pellet along its injection trajectory. For an axisymmetric equilibrium it depends only on the major-radius and vertical coordinates of that trajectory point.

sample.name: ratio_of_vertical_vorticity_to_major_radius
sample.description: Vertical plasma vorticity divided by the local major radius, retaining the signed rotation rate about the vertical axis with inverse-length scaling.

sample.name: total_absorbed_wave_power_at_inside_flux_surface
sample.description: Cumulative power transferred from electromagnetic waves to electrons, ions, and fast populations within a selected magnetic flux surface.

sample.name: plasma_mass_density_real_part
sample.description: Real part of a complex plasma mass-density quantity, representing the in-phase quadrature relative to the chosen complex phase. It is the real component only, not the full complex density or its imaginary quadrature.

sample.name: toroidal_coordinate_of_soft_xray_detector
sample.description: Toroidal angle of the geometric center of a soft X-ray detector in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: wave_curvature_of_electron_cyclotron_beam
sample.description: Wave curvature of an electron-cyclotron beam is the signed inverse radius of curvature of its phase front along one selected principal transverse direction of the phase ellipse.

sample.name: volume_averaged_runaway_electron_kinetic_energy_density
sample.description: Mean relativistic kinetic energy per unit volume of the runaway electron population, obtained by averaging the local kinetic energy density over the confined plasma volume.

sample.name: current_density_due_to_non_inductive_current_drive
sample.description: Vector current-density contribution produced by bootstrap and externally driven non-inductive mechanisms, excluding current generated by an inductive electric field.

sample.name: wave_voltage_amplitude
sample.description: Amplitude of the detected voltage signal from a probing microwave wave returned after interaction with the plasma cutoff layer.

sample.name: radius_of_bragg_crystal
sample.description: Geometric distance from the center of a circular Bragg-crystal aperture to the edge of its active diffracting surface.

sample.name: vertical_coordinate_of_lower_hybrid_antenna
sample.description: Vertical Z-coordinate of the reference point of a lower-hybrid antenna in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: normalized_poloidal_flux_coordinate_at_minimum_absolute_safety_factor
sample.description: Dimensionless normalized poloidal-flux coordinate locating the closed magnetic surface where the safety-factor magnitude is globally minimized.

sample.name: poloidal_suprathermal_electron_angle_perturbed_at_ece_channel_emission_position
sample.description: Poloidal angular offset estimate of the electron cyclotron emission measurement position due to the presence of suprathermal electrons, relative to the thermal-electron emission reference.

sample.name: second_local_tangential_coordinate_of_hard_xray_detector
sample.description: Signed coordinate of a hard X-ray detector outline vertex along the second local tangential axis of the right-handed detector-local Cartesian basis (first local tangential, second local tangential, local normal).

sample.name: power_due_to_first_orbit_loss
sample.description: Power carried out of the confined fast-ion population by particles whose first guiding-center orbit after birth or acceleration is unconfined; it is a positive loss magnitude.

sample.name: magnetic_field_magnitude
sample.description: Scalar magnetic-field-strength quantity derived from the local total magnetic-induction vector, retaining its magnitude or using that magnitude in an aggregation or algebraic transformation.

sample.name: total_plasma_radiated_power
sample.description: Total plasma radiated power is the electromagnetic power emitted by the full plasma, summed over all photon-emission mechanisms and integrated over the plasma volume.

sample.name: neutral_gas_pressure_of_gauge
sample.description: Neutral gas pressure of a gage is the pressure indicated by a barometry gage for residual neutral gas in the vacuum vessel or surrounding vacuum system. It represents local vacuum conditions rather than a kinetic neutral-particle pressure moment.

sample.name: poloidal_perturbed_vacuum_magnetic_field
sample.description: Complex poloidal component of the first-order magnetic-field perturbation eigenfunction in the current-free vacuum region outside the plasma boundary, for a single toroidal Fourier mode in linear MHD stability analysis.

sample.name: time
sample.description: Temporal measure expressing an elapsed interval or characteristic duration, including the time denominator used to define a physical rate.

sample.name: flux_surface_averaged_time_averaged_normalized_perturbed_parallel_magnetic_field_magnitude
sample.description: Dimensionless compressional electromagnetic fluctuation amplitude from the parallel magnetic-field perturbation, time- and flux-surface-averaged and summed over kx for each ky.

sample.name: parallel_electric_field
sample.description: Parallel electric-field component giving the force per unit positive stationary test charge along the local magnetic-field direction, including electrostatic, inductive, and electromagnetic-wave contributions.

sample.name: beryllium_density
sample.description: Local number density of beryllium impurity ions per unit plasma volume, summed over all ionization states from singly ionized to fully stripped (Be1+ through Be4+), excluding neutral beryllium atoms.

sample.name: flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_flux_coordinate_gradient_magnitude
sample.description: Geometric metric coefficient formed by averaging the local magnitude of the toroidal-flux-coordinate gradient over each nested magnetic flux surface.

sample.name: toroidal_magnetic_field_at_pedestal_top
sample.description: Signed toroidal component of the magnetic induction evaluated on the low-field-side, core-side shoulder of the H-mode pressure pedestal.

sample.name: volume_averaged_ion_charge_state_average_charge_number
sample.description: Volume average of the local density-weighted mean charge number of an ion charge-state bundle over the confined plasma volume.

sample.name: flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_current_density
sample.description: Geometry-weighted flux-surface average of the net conventional toroidal current density driving the equilibrium poloidal magnetic-flux distribution.

sample.name: area_of_toroidal_field_coil
sample.description: Non-negative geometric area of the conducting material within a toroidal-field-coil conductor’s cross-sectional boundary, measured normal to its local centerline.

sample.name: volume_of_pellet_fragment
sample.description: Geometric volume occupied by the material of an individual shattered pellet fragment, distinguishing fragment size from the intact pellet and surrounding propellant.

sample.name: perpendicular_normalized_perturbed_pressure_bessel_1
sample.description: Perpendicular normalized perturbed pressure Bessel-1 is the perpendicular pressure moment of a perturbed gyrocenter distribution in a linear gyrokinetic eigenmode, normalized to a reference thermal pressure and weighted by the first-order Bessel function J1.

sample.name: height_of_plasma_filament
sample.description: Full vertical extent of the rectangular cross-section of a discrete plasma current-carrying filament element, measured along the machine’s vertical axis.

sample.name: viewing_efficiency_of_spectrometer_channel
sample.description: Fraction of locally emitted light collected by a spectrometer channel’s optical system from each specified region-of-interest point, including non-pinhole viewing geometries.

sample.name: vertical_coordinate_of_ion_cyclotron_heating_antenna
sample.description: Vertical Z coordinate of the reference point associated with an ion-cyclotron heating antenna in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: line_integrated_electron_number_density
sample.description: Free-electron column density accumulated along a complete electromagnetic propagation path, including both forward and return segments when present.

sample.name: nuclear_heating_power_of_breeder_blanket_layer
sample.description: Total rate of heat generated within one breeder-blanket material layer by neutron and photon interactions, excluding external and surface heat loads.

sample.name: electrostatic_potential_amplitude
sample.description: Normalized phase-independent magnitude of an electrostatic-potential fluctuation relative to its reference field. It describes amplitude only, not the signed potential perturbation or its phase.

sample.name: first_local_tangential_width_of_diagnostic_aperture
sample.description: Full clear-opening extent of a rectangular diagnostic aperture along its object-local first tangential axis, used to define the aperture geometry for étendue calculations.

sample.name: first_local_tangential_coordinate_of_soft_xray_detector
sample.description: Signed coordinate of a soft X-ray detector outline vertex along the first local tangential (X1) axis of the detector-local two-dimensional Cartesian frame.

sample.name: alfven_frequency_imaginary_part
sample.description: Damping rate when negative or growth rate when positive, the imaginary part of the complex shear Alfvén continuum frequency, for a single toroidal mode number at a given radial position.

sample.name: electrostatic_potential_real_part
sample.description: Electrostatic potential real part is the real-valued quadrature of a complex electrostatic-potential representation. It identifies the in-phase scalar-potential component, not the full complex potential or its magnitude.

sample.name: derivative_of_volume_of_flux_surface_with_respect_to_poloidal_magnetic_flux_coordinate
sample.description: Geometric rate of change of the cumulative volume enclosed by a nested magnetic flux surface as its signed poloidal flux coordinate varies.

sample.name: total_thermal_coolant_absorbed_power_at_wall
sample.description: Thermal power extracted by active coolant circuits from cooled plasma-facing wall surfaces, representing energy removal from the wall rather than incident plasma power.

sample.name: poloidal_gyrocenter_frequency
sample.description: Poloidal component of gyrocenter orbit angular frequency, equal to the signed rate of gyrocenter advance in poloidal angle θ within flux coordinates (ρ, θ, φ).

sample.name: parallel_refractive_index
sample.description: Parallel refractive index is the signed component of the refractive-index vector projected onto the local equilibrium magnetic-field direction, equal to the parallel wave-vector component normalized by the vacuum wavenumber.

sample.name: incident_energy_flux_at_wall_due_to_eddy_current
sample.description: Local energy flux density entering each plasma-facing wall element from the plasma side, attributed specifically to eddy-current processes rather than emitted wall energy.

sample.name: etendue_of_soft_xray_detector
sample.description: Geometric optical throughput of a soft X-ray detector channel, set by the collecting area and accepted solid angle of its optical system.

sample.name: diameter_of_diagnostic_aperture
sample.description: Full transverse diameter of a circular diagnostic aperture, measured across its center between opposite points on the circumferential boundary.

sample.name: source_rate_due_to_injection
sample.description: Source rate due to injection is the instantaneous rate of electron-equivalent particles supplied by active injection, formed by nuclear-charge weighting of the injected species. It represents the injection-only material source and excludes particle production or loss after injection.

sample.name: initial_polarization_ellipticity_of_polarimeter_beam
sample.description: Signed ratio of the minor to major semiaxes of the electric-field polarization ellipse of a polarimeter probing beam in its incident state, before plasma entry. It gives only the ellipticity component of the initial polarization vector, not the ellipse orientation.

sample.name: volume_averaged_total_ion_temperature
sample.description: Density-weighted effective temperature of the combined thermal ion population, with all included species and charge states contributing by number density and averaged over the confined plasma volume.

sample.name: fast_ion_charge_state_power_density
sample.description: Absorbed wave power density deposited on fast (non-thermal) ions in a specified charge state, expressed per unit plasma volume.

sample.name: temperature_of_coil_conductor
sample.description: Thermodynamic temperature of the conductor in an active poloidal-field or central-solenoid coil, used to establish its allowable current limit.

sample.name: nuclear_heating_power_of_limiter_tile
sample.description: Nuclear heating power of a limiter tile is the rate at which nuclear energy is deposited within one limiter tile by neutron interactions and associated primary and secondary gamma-ray absorption.

sample.name: poloidal_ion_velocity_at_charge_exchange_channel
sample.description: Poloidal ion velocity at measurement position is the signed poloidal component of the ion flow velocity evaluated at the physical location of a measurement channel.

sample.name: current_due_to_fusion_reactions
sample.description: Net parallel plasma current generated by fusion reactions, associated with fast alpha particles produced by deuterium–tritium reactions and distinct from other non-inductive current-drive mechanisms.

sample.name: safety_factor_at_internal_transport_barrier
sample.description: Signed field-line winding ratio evaluated on the magnetic flux surface designated as the internal transport barrier, giving toroidal turns per poloidal circuit.

sample.name: total_neutron_rate
sample.description: Total neutron emission rate produced by deuterium–tritium, deuterium–deuterium, and tritium–tritium fusion reactions in the plasma.

sample.name: maximum_of_back_surface_neutron_flux
sample.description: Maximum neutron energy flux escaping through the rear surface of a breeding blanket module toward vessel structures.

sample.name: radial_coordinate_of_active_wall_point
sample.description: Major-radius coordinate of the active wall point where the plasma boundary contacts the wall, expressed in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: intensity_at_spectral_line
sample.description: Uncalibrated photoelectron detection rate obtained by integrating the measured emission signal across an identified spectral line.

sample.name: square_of_toroidal_flux_coordinate_gradient_magnitude
sample.description: Squared spatial gradient of a toroidal magnetic-flux coordinate, providing a geometric coefficient for equilibrium descriptions in physical space.

sample.name: ratio_of_neutral_density_of_isotope_to_difference_of_total_neutral_density_and_neutral_density_of_isotope
sample.description: Odds ratio of the neutral density of a selected hydrogen isotope to the summed neutral density of all other hydrogen isotopes, distinguishing composition odds from total isotope fraction.

sample.name: radial_outline_of_coil_conductor_element
sample.description: Non-negative major-radius coordinate of a point on the cross-sectional outline of an active poloidal-field coil conductor element in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: toroidal_angle_of_active_limiter_point
sample.description: Toroidal angle φ of the active limiter point, the contact location where a limited plasma boundary touches the limiter surface, in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: ratio_of_ion_density_to_electron_density
sample.description: Local ion concentration relative to the electron population, defined as the number-density ratio for a specified impurity or fuel ion species.

sample.name: y_coordinate_of_ferritic_element_centroid
sample.description: Signed y coordinate of the geometric centroid of a ferritic element in the right-handed Cartesian (x, y, z) frame, with z aligned to vertical Z.

sample.name: radius_of_neutral_beam_injector
sample.description: Radius of the circular ion-source surface from which neutral beams are extracted, defining the radial extent of its extraction aperture.

sample.name: torque_due_to_collisions
sample.description: Net torque transferred to a plasma particle population through collisional interactions with other particles, expressed as the corresponding rate of angular-momentum change.

sample.name: vertical_velocity_at_current_center
sample.description: Vertical velocity of the plasma-current centroid, defined by the rate of change of its vertical position.

sample.name: toroidal_rotation_frequency_due_to_e_cross_b_drift
sample.description: Toroidal angular frequency due to the E-cross-B drift is the species-independent electric-field cross magnetic-field contribution to toroidal motion, equal to its toroidal velocity component divided by local major radius in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: ratio_of_toroidal_ion_velocity_to_magnetic_field_magnitude
sample.description: Signed ratio of the charge-state-averaged toroidal ion bulk velocity to the local magnetic-field magnitude, retaining the toroidal flow contribution.

sample.name: shattered_pellet_species_number_density_of_pellet_fragment
sample.description: Number density of a specified atomic species within the solid material of an individual shattered-pellet fragment.

sample.name: temperature_of_soft_xray_detector
sample.description: Thermodynamic temperature of the soft X-ray detector assembly, describing its physical thermal state for calibration and monitoring rather than a plasma temperature inferred from radiation.

sample.name: resistance_of_toroidal_field_coil
sample.description: Ohmic resistance of a toroidal-field-coil winding, relating its current to the resistive voltage drop and Joule power dissipation.

sample.name: toroidal_launched_wave_index_of_lower_hybrid_antenna
sample.description: Signed toroidal component of the refractive-index vector for a lower-hybrid wave launched by a lower-hybrid antenna.

sample.name: vertical_displacement_of_beamlet_group
sample.description: Signed vertical displacement of a neutral-beam-injection beamlet-group center from its static geometry during dynamic beam tilting.

sample.name: radial_outline_of_ferritic_element
sample.description: Non-negative major-radius coordinate of a point on a ferritic element outline in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: derivative_of_logarithm_of_density_with_respect_to_normalized_minor_radius
sample.description: Signed logarithmic derivative of a selected particle-species density with respect to normalized minor radius, expressing the relative change of that density as the normalized minor-radius coordinate increases. For charge-state-aggregated ion species, the density is summed over all charge states.

sample.name: radial_length_of_divertor_target
sample.description: Non-negative span of a divertor target’s plasma-facing surface along the major-radius direction, measured between its minimum and maximum R coordinates.

sample.name: core_atomic_count_of_pellet
sample.description: Core atomic count of a pellet is the total inventory of individual atoms contained in its core material, independent of bonding, phase, or species.

sample.name: surface_area_of_neutron_detector
sample.description: Geometric area of the neutron-sensitive detector surface, excluding passive housing, shielding, supports, electronics, projection effects, and solid-angle weighting.

sample.name: current_due_to_lower_hybrid_current_drive
sample.description: Net toroidal plasma current driven non-inductively by lower-hybrid slow waves through wave–particle interactions, contributing to the total non-inductive current.

sample.name: nuclear_power_density_of_limiter_tile
sample.description: Local volumetric rate of nuclear energy deposition in limiter-tile material from neutron interactions and associated absorption of primary and secondary gamma radiation.

sample.name: total_lower_gas_source_rate_of_vacuum_vessel_due_to_gas_injection
sample.description: Instantaneous total rate at which neutral gas is introduced into the lower vacuum-vessel region by gas injection valves, summed over lower-region valves and expressed using the equivalent-electron convention across injected species.

sample.name: time_averaged_normalized_perturbed_parallel_magnetic_field_magnitude
sample.description: Time-averaged normalized perturbed parallel magnetic-field magnitude is the time-averaged amplitude of a magnetic-field perturbation projected along the local equilibrium magnetic field and normalized by a reference magnetic-field magnitude. It does not include flux-surface averaging unless a more specific name states that aggregation.

sample.name: ratio_of_volume_averaged_carbon_density_to_volume_averaged_electron_density
sample.description: Dimensionless plasma-wide carbon abundance defined as the ratio of volume-averaged carbon number density to volume-averaged electron number density. The carbon density is summed over all carbon charge states.

sample.name: mhd_mode_reference_phase
sample.description: Signed angular offset that fixes the complex phase of a mode relative to its zero-phase reference.

sample.name: radius_of_neutron_detector
sample.description: Radius of the circular collimating aperture forming a neutron detector’s sensitive opening, measured from its center to the circumferential boundary.

sample.name: reference_frequency_of_wave_beam
sample.description: Reference temporal carrier frequency of a probing electromagnetic wave beam, specified before frequency conversion or modulation and used as the phase-measurement baseline.

sample.name: second_local_tangential_coordinate_of_soft_xray_detector
sample.description: Signed coordinate of a soft X-ray detector outline vertex along the second local tangential (X2) axis of the detector-local right-handed Cartesian frame.

sample.name: plasma_temperature_imaginary_part
sample.description: Imaginary part of plasma temperature is the quadrature component of a complex-valued plasma-temperature quantity. It is the coefficient of the imaginary basis element and is distinct from both the real part and the full complex temperature.

sample.name: turn_count_of_toroidal_magnetic_field_probe
sample.description: Signed number of complete winding turns in a toroidal magnetic-field probe coil, with orientation referenced to the positive toroidal direction.

sample.name: vertical_coordinate_of_polarizer
sample.description: Vertical coordinate of a polarizer is the signed Z position of the polarizer geometric center in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: saturated_ion_current
sample.description: Ion charge flux collected by a Langmuir probe at the ion-saturation limit, expressed as the non-negative magnitude of the area-integrated ion current when electron collection is suppressed.

sample.name: voltage_of_shunt
sample.description: Signed terminal-potential difference across a resistive shunt, providing the voltage used with its resistance to determine current in an associated structure segment.

sample.name: momentum_flux_normalized_due_to_perturbed_parallel_vector_potential
sample.description: Dimensionless toroidal plasma-momentum flux contribution driven by the perturbed parallel electromagnetic vector potential in gyrokinetic turbulence, generalized across parallel and perpendicular velocity-space channels.

sample.name: normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate_of_neoclassical_tearing_mode_center
sample.description: Dimensionless magnetic-surface label locating the resonant flux surface at the center of a neoclassical tearing-mode magnetic island.

sample.name: resistance_of_ion_cyclotron_heating_antenna
sample.description: Resistance of an ion-cyclotron heating antenna is the real part of the effective radio-frequency loading impedance at the antenna feed reference plane. It represents the resistive component associated with power coupled to the plasma and dissipative antenna losses.

sample.name: flux_surface_averaged_parallel_electric_field_at_separatrix
sample.description: Flux-surface average of the signed electric-field projection along the magnetic field, taken over the separatrix rather than at a single point.

sample.name: second_local_tangential_coordinate_of_filter
sample.description: Second local tangential coordinate of a filter boundary point is the signed position of that point along the filter's second in-plane basis direction in the object-local planar frame attached to the filter.

sample.name: toroidal_angle_of_grating
sample.description: Toroidal azimuthal coordinate of the center of the surface on which a grating image is focused, locating that image-field center around the machine symmetry axis.

sample.name: particle_source_rate_due_to_distribution_function_driven
sample.description: Net volumetric particle production or loss generated by kinetic distribution-function sources and entering a particle continuity or density-transport equation.

sample.name: vertical_outline_of_fiber_optic_current_sensor
sample.description: Signed vertical Z coordinate of a contour point defining the geometric boundary of a fiber-optic current sensor in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: spectral_efficiency_of_hard_xray_detector
sample.description: Energy-dependent probability that a photon impacting a hard X-ray detector is registered by its detection system.

sample.name: hot_neutral_velocity
sample.description: Hot neutral velocity is the line-of-sight component of the bulk flow of an energetic neutral atom population, identified from the Doppler centroid shift of its broad emission component.

sample.name: total_plasma_mass_density
sample.description: Local total plasma mass per unit volume, obtained by summing the masses of all charged species and charge states while excluding neutral atoms and molecules.

sample.name: y_coordinate_of_divertor_target
sample.description: Signed Cartesian y-coordinate locating the geometric center of the divertor target surface in the right-handed Cartesian (x, y, z) frame; positive values lie along the +y axis.

sample.name: flux_at_limiter
sample.description: Flux at a limiter is the local surface rate density at which an energy-dimensioned plasma-borne quantity is deposited on the plasma-facing surface of a limiter. It fixes the limiter locus and the local surface-flux character; more specific quantities state the energy channel being carried, as in energy flux at limiter.

sample.name: toroidal_coordinate_of_filter_window
sample.description: Toroidal angular coordinate of a filter window’s geometric center, locating the window around the symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: vertical_coordinate_of_antenna_strap
sample.description: Vertical coordinate of the annular geometric center of an ion-cyclotron antenna strap in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: effective_charge
sample.description: Dimensionless effective ionic charge of a plasma mixture, given by the second ionic charge moment divided by free-electron density and indicating impurity content.

sample.name: momentum_flux_normalized_due_to_e_cross_b_drift
sample.description: Normalized momentum flux due to E×B drift is the dimensionless transport of resolved linear plasma momentum across an oriented surface by the electric-field drift. Concrete specializations supply the momentum component, crossing direction, velocity-space contribution, and normalization reference.

sample.name: total_electron_count
sample.description: Total inventory of free electrons within the plasma, including thermal and fast populations and excluding electrons bound in atoms or molecules.

sample.name: radial_coordinate_of_coil_conductor_element
sample.description: Major-radius coordinate of the geometric center associated with a coil-conductor element, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: upper_wavelength_of_filter
sample.description: Upper wavelength of a filter is the vacuum-wavelength coordinate marking the long-wavelength, low-frequency edge of its transmitted spectral band.

sample.name: toroidal_thermal_ion_torque_density_due_to_thermalization
sample.description: Signed toroidal component of the local collisional angular-momentum transfer rate per unit volume deposited in thermal ions by fast-particle thermalization.

sample.name: radius_of_filter_window
sample.description: Geometric distance from the center of a circular filter-window aperture to its circumferential boundary, defining the window’s radial size.

sample.name: alpha_angle_of_passive_loop_element
sample.description: Signed inclination of the first axis of an oblique passive conductor loop-element cross-section, measured counterclockwise from the outward radial direction in the poloidal plane.

sample.name: incident_neutral_particle_flux_at_wall_due_to_recombination
sample.description: Incident number flux density of neutral recombination products arriving at a plasma-facing wall, summed over neutral species and internal states.

sample.name: ion_charge_state_lower_bound_charge
sample.description: Lower charge-number bound of an ion charge-state bundle is the smallest integer ionization charge number included in the bundle. For a single charge state, the lower and upper charge-number bounds are equal.

sample.name: radial_current_density_due_to_ion_neutral_friction
sample.description: Radial component of the electric current density produced by frictional momentum exchange between plasma ions and background neutral particles in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: beryllium_source_rate_due_to_gas_injection
sample.description: Instantaneous equivalent-electron source rate of beryllium atoms introduced by gas injection, with four equivalent electrons assigned to each atom.

sample.name: vertical_front_surface_radius_of_optical_element
sample.description: Radius of curvature of an optical element's beam-entry front surface along the local second tangential direction (X2, the optical-element vertical direction) in the right-handed local optical-element frame (X1, X2, z).

sample.name: electron_density_at_pellet_path
sample.description: Local free-electron number density of the background plasma at points along a pellet's ablation trajectory.

sample.name: normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate_at_beam_tracing_point
sample.description: Dimensionless magnetic-surface label assigned to each point along a traced electromagnetic-wave beam, locating that propagation point within nested toroidal-flux geometry.

sample.name: normalized_perturbed_parallel_magnetic_field_magnitude
sample.description: Normalized perturbed parallel magnetic-field magnitude is the nonnegative amplitude of a magnetic-field perturbation projected along the local equilibrium magnetic-field direction and divided by a reference magnetic-field magnitude. More specific names may add averaging conventions.

sample.name: perpendicular_wave_vector_of_ion_cyclotron_heating_antenna
sample.description: Non-negative magnitude of the RF wave-vector component perpendicular to the local equilibrium magnetic field launched by an ion-cyclotron heating antenna.

sample.name: radius_of_detector
sample.description: Radius from the center to the circumferential edge of a detector's circular front face, defining its geometric size for optical throughput.

sample.name: radius_of_coil_conductor_element
sample.description: Curvature radius of each circular arc used to define the cross-sectional contour of an active poloidal-field coil conductor element.

sample.name: flux_surface_averaged_current_density_due_to_wave_driven_current_drive
sample.description: Vector average on a magnetic flux surface of conventional plasma current density generated non-inductively by electromagnetic-wave–particle interactions, excluding inductive and non-wave current drive.

sample.name: current_density_due_to_fast_ion
sample.description: Vector density of electric current carried by a specified charged-particle contribution, obtained from its signed charge-weighted particle flux.

sample.name: electron_particle_flux_at_wall_due_to_pumping
sample.description: Rate at which particles represented as equivalent electrons are removed from the plasma region by wall pumping, giving global electron-equivalent exhaust throughput.

sample.name: current_of_rogowski_coil
sample.description: Signed conventional current threading a Rogowski-coil winding contour, with orientation set by the coil's assigned normal.

sample.name: major_length_of_plasma_filament
sample.description: Length of the major oblique side of a plasma-filament cross-section, inclined relative to the major-radius axis and distinct from the height-oriented side.

sample.name: normalized_poloidal_flux_coordinate_of_pedestal
sample.description: Dimensionless poloidal-flux label locating the H-mode edge transport-barrier pedestal between the magnetic axis and the last closed flux surface.

sample.name: resistance_of_poloidal_field_coil
sample.description: Ohmic resistance of an individual poloidal-field coil winding, relating its resistive voltage drop to current and determining Joule dissipation.

sample.name: breakdown_magnetic_field
sample.description: Breakdown magnetic-field strength associated with local magnetic induction during plasma initiation, without selecting a particular source contribution or field-strength representation.

sample.name: spectral_calibration_factor_at_line_of_sight
sample.description: Wavelength-specific interferometric conversion coefficient that converts a signed phase change along a line of sight into electron column density.

sample.name: thickness_of_bragg_crystal
sample.description: Physical thickness of a Bragg crystal is the normal material thickness measured between its opposing surfaces along the local surface normal. It excludes the X-ray ray-path length through the crystal, which depends on incidence geometry.

sample.name: first_local_tangential_coordinate_of_optical_element
sample.description: Signed position of an optical-element outline vertex along the first local tangential axis in the orthogonal element-local tangential basis.

sample.name: power_of_divertor_due_to_ohmic_dissipation
sample.description: Power deposited on all divertor targets by irreversible electrical-current dissipation, summed over the complete divertor assembly.

sample.name: y_coordinate_of_sensor_attachment_point
sample.description: Signed Cartesian y coordinate of the point where a sensor is mechanically attached to a device component, in the right-handed Cartesian (x, y, z) machine frame with z vertical.

sample.name: second_local_tangential_width_of_filter_window
sample.description: Full aperture extent of one rectangular filter window along its object-local second tangential axis, distinct from the window’s orthogonal width and curvature radius.

sample.name: total_power_at_separatrix
sample.description: Net energy power leaving the confined plasma through the last closed magnetic flux surface and entering the scrape-off layer.

sample.name: radial_offset_of_beamlet_group
sample.description: Signed major-radius displacement of a beamlet-group center from its nominal position, measured along the radial direction in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: radial_coordinate_of_thomson_scattering_laser
sample.description: Major-radius location of the Thomson-scattering laser endpoint, measured as perpendicular distance from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

sample.name: minor_radius_of_plasma_boundary
sample.description: Half the difference between the maximum and minimum major-radius coordinates of the last closed plasma-boundary contour, defining its horizontal cross-sectional size.

sample.name: parallel_effective_neutral_internal_state_momentum_velocity_due_to_convection
sample.description: Parallel effective neutral internal-state momentum velocity due to convection is the signed, field-aligned component of the effective convection velocity representing transport of momentum carried by neutrals in a resolved internal state. The parallel direction is along the local magnetic field.

sample.name: alpha_angle_of_plasma_filament
sample.description: Signed inclination of the first side of a plasma-filament oblique cross-section, measured counterclockwise from the outward radial direction in the poloidal plane.
